blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — US President Donald Trump said Saturday he was offering a press secretary role to mixed martial arts executive and “violent fighter” Dana White. “I am pleased to announce that the Great Dana White, a violent Fighter and Warrior, has been offered the job of Press Secretary of the United States,” Trump wrote
